I recall a particularly challenging project where I had to optimize our machine learning pipeline for predicting patient outcomes in biotech. 

We were struggling with feature engineering and data duplication across multiple teams. 
Our data scientists were spending too much time on data prep, and our models weren't generalizing well.

That's when I discovered Databricks Feature Store. 
I used the `databricks feature-store` CLI to set up a centralized feature store, 
and integrated it with our Apache Spark workflows using `spark.read.format("delta").load()`.

We defined features like `patient_diagnosis` and `treatment_outcome` using the `Feature` class, 
and computed them using Delta Lake's `MERGE` statement.

The results were impressive - our data scientists saved over 30% of their time on feature engineering, 
and our model accuracy improved by 25%. 

The best part? 
We reduced data duplication by 50% across teams, thanks to the feature store's centralized management.

I'd love to share more on how I implemented this and overcame challenges.
